newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran says first nuclear plant unit on stream soon.
newsitem.headline: Iran says first nuclear plant unit on stream soon.

text.p: Iran said on Monday it would soon start operating the first unit of its nuclear power plant in the Gulf port of Bushehr.
Iranian Atomic Energy Organisation head Reza Amrollahi, quoted by state-run Tehran radio, said the unit would "soon" come on stream, producing 1,000 megawatts of electricity. He did not elaborate.
Amrollahi had said in January the plant, being completed with Russian help under an $800 million contract, would come on stream in three years.
Washington, which accuses Tehran of seeking to develop nuclear arms, has strongly urged Moscow to abandon the project.
Iran has repeatedly denied the charges, saying its nuclear programme was strictly civilian.

Amrollahi also said on Monday Iran had expressed concern over recent U.S. nuclear weapons-related tests and slammed the explosions as contrary to international nuclear test ban treaties, the radio reported.
He said Tehran had sent a complaint to the secretary-general of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA).
Washington has said the experiments last week were designed to test materials without triggering the kind of nuclear chain reactions prohibited by an international treaty last year.
